trends.name: Iran Ceasefire Collapse & Oil Shock
trends.summary: US-Iran ceasefire talks failing with Iran blocking Strait of Hormuz transit (capped at 15 vessels/day vs. normal 135/day). Oil climbed above $100 as negotiations stalled; Trump administration pressuring for resolution but Iran asserting control. Only ~55% chance traffic normalizes before July 1, creating sustained energy market stress and inflation risk.

trends.name: AI Infrastructure & Regulatory Bottlenecks
trends.summary: OpenAI pauses UK Stargate project over regulation and power costs amid surging AI capex concerns. Simultaneously, Alibaba revealed leading AI video model and investing $290M in new model architecture as LLM limitations emerge. Tension between AI demand and infrastructure/regulatory constraints reshaping sector investment thesis.

trends.name: TSMC AI Chip Dominance & Revenue Records
trends.summary: TSMC posts 35% revenue jump to record highs despite geopolitical tensions, with AI chip demand driving growth trajectory. Company forecast-beating results signal sustained semiconductor strength and Taiwan's critical role in AI supply chain, reinforcing structural demand thesis for chip manufacturers.

trends.name: Record M&A Dealmaking & Corporate Consolidation
trends.summary: Global M&A jumped 18% YoY in Q1 2026 to record $1.25 trillion, including Unilever's $44.8B food sale and Sysco's $29.1B acquisition. Strong insider buying (26.4% of companies with net purchases in March, highest in 5 months) suggests corporate confidence and potential mega-deals reshaping sector valuations.

trends.name: Middle East Military Escalation Risk
trends.summary: Over 70 transport planes landed in Middle East within 24 hours of ceasefire, suggesting Trump administration regrouping for potential ground offensive. Netanyahu's unprecedented call for 'peaceful relations' contradicts massive Lebanon bombardments; drone attacks from Iraq hitting Kuwait. Geopolitical instability threatens to undermine ceasefire sustainability and energy markets.

trends.name: AI vs. Cybersecurity & Competitive War
trends.summary: OpenAI shareholder memo attacks Anthropic as rival gains momentum; Anthropic's Mythos model raises security implications. Competition intensifying as multimodal AI (video, text) capabilities advance, creating winner-take-most dynamics. Investor focus on which AI platforms capture enterprise defensibility and moat sustainability.

trends.name: Cloud/SaaS Valuation Repricing
trends.summary: Snowflake positioned as 'buy' despite panic selling as markets reassess SaaS valuation multiples post-capex concerns. Microsoft's temporary capex panic masks long-term AI edge. Investors distinguishing between structural AI winners and companies facing margin compression from infrastructure costs.

trends.name: US-EU Tech Regulation & Trade Tensions
trends.summary: EU Big Tech fines topped $7 billion in 2 years, angering Trump administration as regulatory divergence widens. UK PM Starmer criticizes Trump/Putin for affecting energy costs. Growing friction between US and European tech regulation creating compliance costs and geopolitical decoupling risk for multinational tech firms.

trends.name: Food Inflation & Commodities Crisis
trends.summary: Grocery prices surging with Doritos bag now $7 (vs $3.49 in 2009); Iran conflict threatening further food inflation through resource scarcity. Manganese mining and oil price spikes compressing agricultural margins. Investors positioning in commodity hedges and food-linked equities as consumer staples valuations adjust.

trends.name: Central Bank Policy Divergence & Rate Holds
trends.summary: Bank of Korea holds rates steady with data-dependent outlook; Swiss consumer confidence crashes to -42.9 (vs est -32.4), signaling economic stress. Italian industrial output misses estimates. Global monetary policy diverging as geopolitical shocks create uneven growth, complicating Fed intervention timing decisions.

trends.name: Emerging Market Stress & European Weakness
trends.summary: Europe facing multiple headwinds: Germany restricting emigration to prevent military draft, Switzerland showing consumer collapse, Italy's weak industrial output. Global strategists emphasize emerging markets as essential portfolio hedge. Suggests portfolio repositioning toward diversification amid regional economic fragility and geopolitical militarization.

trends.name: Biodiversity/Sustainability Themes Gaining Weight
trends.summary: Water risk and AI's hidden environmental costs emerging as investor focus areas. Hydrogen plays (ITM Power) and sustainable mining gaining attention as ESG concerns intersect with supply chain criticality (manganese, rare earths). Signals shift in how investors price climate/resource constraints into equity valuations.
